inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read the Zodiac-Team Lens in Your Chart
inline.afterHeadingZh: ## 如何在你自己身上识别星座球队透镜
inline.titleEn: How to Read Your Zodiac Playing Style
inline.titleZh: 如何解读你的星座球风
inline.altEn: Five-step sequence for reading your zodiac sign as a World Cup 2026 playing style through element and modality
inline.altZh: 通过元素与形态解读星座对应2026年世界杯球风的五个步骤

items.subEn: Identify your Sun sign and its element: fire, earth, air, or water
items.subZh: 找到你的太阳星座和它的元素——火、土、风，还是水

items.subEn: Fire = attack and flair; earth = structure and stamina; air = passing and tactics; water = intuition and flow
items.subZh: 火=进攻与灵光；土=结构与耐力；风=传球与战术；水=直觉与流动

items.subEn: Cardinal signs start moves, fixed signs hold shape, mutable signs adapt mid-play
items.subZh: 基本星座发起进攻，固定星座守住阵型，变动星座中途应变

items.subEn: Map yourself to a style of team rather than a forecast for any nation
items.subZh: 把自己对应到一种球队风格，而不是给哪个国家的预测

items.subEn: This is a metaphor for temperament, not a scouting report
items.subZh: 用星座看世界杯球队是气质的比喻，不是球探报告

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## The Zodiac-Team Lens at a Glance
inline.titleEn: The Four Elements as Playing Styles

inline.altZh: 火象、土象、水象星座作为2026年世界杯球风对比，展示代表星座与球风特征

linesEn: A team that chases the opening and entertains
linesZh: 扑向空当、踢得好看的队

linesEn: A side that holds shape and grinds out results
linesZh: 守住阵型、磨出结果的队

linesEn: Play that reads the moment and shifts with feeling
linesZh: 读得懂当下、随感觉切换的踢法
